name: promptus
description: A file-based research knowledge system — a substrate for the LLM agent: store / keep / retrieve what a project knows as gated markdown, navigable by status and a [[link]] graph. grannie is the human read-port (plain-language, grounded answers).

interface.shortDescription: Gated research memory for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Store, keep, retrieve, and explain a project's research knowledge with stable IDs, explicit epistemic status, and a markdown link graph.
defaultPrompt: Use Promptus to record and retrieve this project's research decisions.
Check the Promptus store before making claims about prior work.
